findings.reason: `پڑھی گئی` is a passive verb ('was read') used as the unmarked complement of `نشان زد کرنا`; Urdu marks the state with the perfect participle `پڑھا ہوا` (the Hindi sibling in this same namespace reads `पढ़ा हुआ चिह्नित`), and without `بطور/کے طور پر` the phrase parses as 'marked the was-read'. Both arms are affected, and the plural arm then adds a second passive (`کر دی گئیں`). Meaning is recoverable, so not a blocker; it is the primary bulk-read receipt, so major.
